fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' locks onto the target enemy champion and begins {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself. He gradually stores bullets into his weapon over the duration.
fields.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Bullets Stored|{{ap|5 to 7}}}}
{{st|Bullet Storing Interval Time|{{ap|2.5/4 to 2.5/6|round=4}} seconds}}
fields.description2: ''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.

fields.description4: Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.
fields.notes:
* ''Comeuppance'' refreshes the duration of ''{{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}'' stacks on the target every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* A kill threshold will appear on the [[health bar]] of the target locked onto during the channel, which increases each time '''Akshan''' stores a bullet. If the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} falls below the threshold, their health bar will be framed in red.
** The indicator factors the bonus damage applied by {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}} as well as [[damage modifier|damage modifiers]] and the target's resistances.
** It also factors the projected increase in the target's {{as|'''missing''' health}}, from which each consecutive bullet scales more.
** It updates dynamically over the channel's duration, reacting to fluctuations of the target's health and damage mitigations.
* The {{tip|true sight|reveal}} will linger for 2 seconds after the channel has ended.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the lock-on and will only block a single bullet.
* ''Comeuppance'' will not go on a reduced cooldown if '''Akshan''' {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* ''Comeuppance'' will cancel if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* Damage to structures '''does''' scale with their {{as|'''missing''' health}}.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
* ''Comeuppance'' is special cased to put {{cai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko}} on cooldown when targeting '''Neeko''' and to break the disguise before damaging her.
